codeReview.summary: Clean extraction of shadow-related state and methods from VulkanRenderer into a ShadowSubsystem struct. The ShadowState struct was renamed to ShadowSubsystem with owned init_resources(), init_pipeline(), init_pipeline_skinned(), update_shadows(), upload_shadow_cascades(), set_shadow_cascade_params(), bind_shadow_descriptors(), set_shadow_atlas_view(), destroy_resources(), and destroy_layouts() methods. A ShadowInitContext dependency injection struct avoids circular references between the subsystem and VulkanRenderer. VulkanRenderer delegates via thin wrapper methods preserving the existing public API. Direct field access from shadow_pass.rs was replaced with shadow_cascade_count() and shadow_cascade_depth_bias() accessors. Two-phase destroy (destroy_resources before pre_destroy, destroy_layouts after) correctly handles Vulkan descriptor layout lifecycle constraints. All 197 workspace tests pass with no new clippy warnings.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The ShadowInitContext pattern (dependency injection struct with borrowed VulkanRenderer fields) is a reusable pattern for subsystem extraction. This pattern was used successfully for shadow and should be documented for future subsystem extractions (light, outline, depth_prepass, picking).
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_gfx/src/renderer/shadow.rs:45-51 — ShadowInitContext<'a> struct with context, material_compiler, storage_descriptor_set, shared_empty_descriptor_layout, asset_registry fields. The handoff notes this is the first of 5 subsystem extractions.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Two-phase destroy pattern (destroy_resources before pre_destroy, destroy_layouts after) is needed because Vulkan pipelines reference descriptor set layouts until AssetRegistry drops them. This ordering constraint should be documented for other subsystem extractions.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_gfx/src/renderer/mod.rs:658 — self.shadow.destroy_resources(&self.context) called before self.context.pre_destroy(), and katla_gfx/src/renderer/mod.rs:672 — self.shadow.destroy_layouts(&self.context) called after pre_destroy(). Comment at line 670 explains the ordering rationale.
